Settings

AI Usage & Cost

What the agents have cost to run over the last 30 days, estimated from the token counts Claude reports on every call. "Saved by caching" is what the repeated, unchanged part of each message would have cost without it.

Loading...

Personal To-Do Color

Every personal to-do's card on the Calendar uses this one color, so it's easy to spot personal time at a glance next to business to-dos and other events. Priority shows separately, as the color of the card's left edge.

To-Do Templates

Save a reusable starting point - title, details, estimated time, priority - for a kind of to-do you add often. Picking one on the To-Do page fills in the form for you to review before adding it; it never adds a to-do by itself.

External Calendar Sync

Sync external calendar → Offload
Paste your calendar's private ICS feed URL, then turn this on to pull its events in.
Sync Offload → external calendar
Turn this on, then subscribe to this feed URL from your other calendar app.

Availability

Drag across a day to mark a range of time, then choose what it's for. Ashanti's scheduling (the To-Do bulk-schedule picker, and her own sense of what's free) only ever books into these hours - Blackout is never scheduled into, Business only takes business to-dos, Personal only takes personal to-dos.

Lunch

Reserve lunch on whichever days you pick below. It isn't a fixed block - Ashanti (and your own scheduling) will slide it earlier or later within the flexibility window to stay out of whatever else lands on the calendar that day, but it always stays exactly as long as you set it here.
